# David Gabeau

> David Gabeau builds consumer products that bring people together. He works on Special Projects at a16z, building Cosign in San Francisco. Previously founder and CEO of Tapestry, analyst at Union Square Ventures, and quality engineer at Snap and Lyft.

This guide summarizes the public website. Canonical HTML pages are the primary sources; Markdown companions contain the same essays in a simpler reading format.

## Profile and contact

- [About David Gabeau](https://davidgabeau.com/): Current work, career timeline, projects, and contact links.
- [Email](mailto:davidgabeau92@gmail.com): Contact David directly.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dgabeau/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/davidjgabeau)
- [X](https://x.com/dgabeau)

## Current work

- [Cosign](https://cosign.co): Building a network for technology builders and investors with the a16z New Media team.
- [a16z](https://a16z.com): Special Projects, 2026–present.

## Previous company and products

- [Tapestry](https://usetapestry.dev): David founded and led a team of 12, raised $12.5M, and wound down the company in 2026. Open social graph infrastructure.
- [Zumi](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zumi-chat-dress-up/id6751237911): A multiplayer AI companion built by Tapestry that grew to 160,000 users.
- [Primitives](https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/25/primitives-crypto-wallet-social-network-snapchat-startup/): A Tapestry product for collecting digital art; artists and collectors minted 500,000 NFTs.
- [SSE](https://sse.gg): Open-source Solana trading platform built by Tapestry, with $50M in trading volume in its first two months.

## Side projects

- [Bramble](https://trybramble.ai): A macOS app that turns AI coding sessions into a structured development log.
- [AI Atlas NYC](https://aiatlas.nyc): A market map of New York’s early-stage AI ecosystem, rebuilt nightly.

## Writing

- [All essays](https://davidgabeau.com/writing)
- [RSS / Atom feed](https://davidgabeau.com/feed.xml)
- [What Agents Can Learn From Working Together](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/what-agents-can-learn-from-working-together) — What building Zumi and Catherine Liang’s World of SWECraft research taught me about AI agents, ownership, and finding worthwhile work. [Markdown](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/what-agents-can-learn-from-working-together.md)
- [Serendipities in San Francisco](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/serendipities-in-san-francisco) — Notes from my first two weeks in San Francisco: brain-computer interfaces, AI, building Cosign, and a lot of coffee. [Markdown](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/serendipities-in-san-francisco.md)
- [Building Cosign with the a16z New Media Team](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/building-cosign) — Building Cosign with the a16z New Media team to increase people’s surface area for luck and connect talent to opportunity. [Markdown](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/building-cosign.md)
- [5 lessons from building social AI for 160,000 users](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/zumi-learnings) — What building Zumi for 160,000 users taught me about reciprocal care, multiplayer AI, generative stories, latency, and trust. [Markdown](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/zumi-learnings.md)
- [Crypto’s Broadband Moment](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/crypto-broadband-moment) — Why crypto’s failed consumer experiments look less like a verdict on demand and more like the internet before broadband made the application layer possible. [Markdown](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/crypto-broadband-moment.md)
- [Where Does Value Accrue in Pearl?](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/pearl) — A note on Pearl, the proof-of-useful-work network that mints the PRL token by running real AI workloads on GPUs, and whether the token actually captures the value it creates. [Markdown](https://davidgabeau.com/writing/pearl.md)
